# UPI SDK
> Android Demo Merchant Application for enabling UPI SDK.

Get the UPI SDK documentation :
  
  * [UPI SDK](http://merchant-doc-v3.bitballoon.com/)

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<android.support.constraint.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    tools:context="com.example.sdk_demo_app.SDKResponse">

    <ScrollView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content">
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/finalStatus"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent" />
    </ScrollView>

</android.support.constraint.ConstraintLayout>
